PropertyTypes.Caption: Signal subscriptions
PropertyTypes.Description: Signals to be subscribed

PropertyTypes.Caption: Signal Name
PropertyTypes.Description: Name of the singal to be subscribed

PropertyTypes.Caption: App Name
PropertyTypes.Description: Name of the Opcenter EX FN App that publishes the Signal

PropertyTypes.Caption: Subscription Filter
PropertyTypes.Description: A string (optional) used to filter messages

PropertyTypes.Caption: Action
PropertyTypes.Description:
Action to be performed that is invoked every time a new message is received from the
                                signal

PropertyTypes.Caption: Event output
PropertyTypes.Description: Attribute in which to store the message received from signal

PropertyTypes.Caption: Throttle (in ms)
PropertyTypes.Description: Useful for rate-limiting event reception that occur too fast.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Show Progress Indicator
PropertyTypes.Description: If set to true in the UI a progress will be displayed until signal is subscribed.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Unsubscribe Signal
PropertyTypes.Description: If set to true the signal will be unsubscibed if previously subscribed.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Enable Heartbeat
PropertyTypes.Description: Enable Heartbeat

PropertyTypes.Caption: Max number of Attempts
PropertyTypes.Description: The maximum number of reconnection attempts allowed

PropertyTypes.Caption: Retry After Delay
PropertyTypes.Description: The time wait (ms) before retrying the request

PropertyTypes.Caption: Unauthorized Callback
PropertyTypes.Description: Action to be executed when unauthorized

DataSource.XPathConstraint:
[($currentObject/ShowCompleteAndNotExecutedOperations = true or WorkOrderStatusNId != 'Complete') 
and ($currentObject/ShowCompleteAndNotExecutedOperations = true or StatusNId != 'Complete') 
and ($currentObject/ShowCompleteAndNotExecutedOperations = true or StatusNId != 'NotExecuted')
and ($currentObject/WorkOrder = empty or starts-with(WorkOrderNId, $currentObject/WorkOrder))
and ($currentObject/Product = empty or (
	OpcenterEXDS_OperatorLanding.ProducedMaterialItems_RM_WorkOrderOperationId/OpcenterEXDS_OperatorLanding.RM_CMX_Filter_ProducedMaterialItem
	[
		starts-with(MaterialTrackingUnitCode, $currentObject/Product)
		and 
		not (MaterialTrackingUnitCode = empty)
	]
	))
and ($currentObject/Machine= empty or (	
      OpcenterEXDS_OperatorLanding.ToBeUsedMachines_RM_WorkOrderOperationId/OpcenterEXDS_OperatorLanding.RM_ToBeUsedMachineWithEquipmentHierarchy
	[
		starts-with(EquipmentNId , $currentObject/Machine)
		and 
		not (EquipmentNId = empty)
	] 
	
    ))
and (not($currentObject/ShowOnlyReadyOperations = true) or ($currentObject/ShowOnlyReadyOperations = true  and IsReady = true))
]

Items.Text: NOTE: Parent container is marked with a class to identify related Work Order to refresh the UI only in case Work Order Operation related to Work Order is in the view. In case if the structue is updated to different one it would be required to keep the same logic to assign dynamic class to ensure the updates with signals.

Parameters.Expression:
if $currentObject/ProductionTypeNId = 'FullQuantity' then
if $currentObject/StatusNId = 'Open' then  
	toString($currentObject/AvailableQuantity)
else if $currentObject/StatusNId = 'Active' or $currentObject/StatusNId = 'Partial'  then  
	toString($currentObject/PartialWorkedQuantity)
else if $currentObject/StatusNId = 'Complete' then  
	toString($currentObject/ProducedQuantity)
else 
	toString($currentObject/TargetQuantity)
else
toString(if $currentObject/AvailableQuantity != empty then $currentObject/AvailableQuantity else 0) + '/' + toString(if $currentObject/PartialWorkedQuantity != empty then $currentObject/PartialWorkedQuantity else 0) + '/' + toString(if $currentObject/ProducedQuantity != empty then $currentObject/ProducedQuantity else 0) + (if $currentObject/ReworkedQuantity != empty and $currentObject/ReworkedQuantity != 0 then '/' + toString($currentObject/ReworkedQuantity) else '')

PropertyTypes.Caption: Attributes
PropertyTypes.Description: Select the attributes that the end-user may use for sorting

PropertyTypes.Caption: Sort order button caption
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching the sort order button.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Input caption
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching the input element.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Style
PropertyTypes.Description: Custom enables placeholders for using widgets for the different states.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Item click toggles selection
PropertyTypes.Description: Defines item selection behavior.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Keep selection
PropertyTypes.Description: If enabled, selected items will stay selected unless cleared by the user or a Nanoflow.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Clear selection label
PropertyTypes.Description: Customize the label of the 'Clear section' button

PropertyTypes.Caption: Show refresh indicator
PropertyTypes.Description: Show a refresh indicator when the data is being loaded.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Store configuration in
PropertyTypes.Description: When Browser local storage is selected, the configuration is scoped to a browser profile. This configuration is not tied to a Mendix user.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Attribute
PropertyTypes.Description: Attribute containing the personalized configuration of the capabilities. This configuration is automatically stored and loaded. The attribute requires Unlimited String.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Filter section
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching a filtering or sorting section.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Empty message
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching an empty message section.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Content description
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching gallery.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Item description
PropertyTypes.Description: Assistive technology will read this upon reaching each gallery item.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Item count singular
PropertyTypes.Description: Must include '%d' to denote number position

PropertyTypes.Caption: Item count plural
PropertyTypes.Description: Must include '%d' to denote number position

DataSource.XPathConstraint:
[(CurrentWorkOrderId = $currentObject/WorkOrderId)
and (($currentObject/ParentFolderId = empty and (ParentEntityId = empty)) or
   ($currentObject/ParentFolderId != empty and (ParentEntityId= $currentObject/ParentFolderId)
))]

Value.Expression:
if $currentObject/IsExternalDependency
then 'external-dependency'
else
if $currentObject/IsPreferred
then 'preferred-dependency'
else ''

PropertyTypes.Caption: Parent node ID *
PropertyTypes.Description: If a graph of nested nodes needs to be rendered a parent node id should be supplied. This can then be used in the edges and nodes datasources to retrieve the correct data. The widget will also change this attribute on double-clicking a node

PropertyTypes.Caption: Zoom to node
PropertyTypes.Description: When a change to this attribute is detected the widget will zoom to the node ID supplied in the attribute. After this the attribute will be cleared.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Zoom nodes
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 2. Defines how many nodes around the target node (the node to zoom in on) should be visible on both the left and right side.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Graph min height
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 500px, minimal height of the graph.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Node width
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 250px

PropertyTypes.Caption: Node height
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 75px

PropertyTypes.Caption: Node spacing x
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 100px

PropertyTypes.Caption: Node spacing y
PropertyTypes.Description: Default: 20px

PropertyTypes.Caption: Has children *
PropertyTypes.Description: If the node has nested/sub nodes

PropertyTypes.Caption: On click action
PropertyTypes.Description: Define a single click action. Double-click will show the sub graph if possible and ctrl + click will zoom on the node

PropertyTypes.Caption: On double-click
PropertyTypes.Description: This action will be triggered along with opening the sub graph (if the node has children). The double click action will always be performed so it can be used to provide feedback when no children are available.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Edge Label
PropertyTypes.Description: Label applied above the edge.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Edge Label Subtitle
PropertyTypes.Description: Label applied below the edge.

PropertyTypes.Caption: CSS Class
PropertyTypes.Description: The class will be applied to both the polyline and the label elements.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Highlighted Source Node ID
PropertyTypes.Description: ID of the source node to highlight in the graph.

PropertyTypes.Caption: Highlighted Destination Node ID
PropertyTypes.Description: ID of the destination node to highlight in the graph.

Type.WidgetDescription: Renders a graph with nodes and edges visualizing the dependencies and relation of the nodes
